reports.title: Joby Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Joby’s current outlook incorporates investment toward certification of our eVTOL aircraft, expansion of manufacturing, and advancement of commercial preparations including participation in the U.S. eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. The company increased its full year 2026 total revenue outlook to a range of $135 million to $140 million. For the second half of 2026, Joby anticipates use of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments to be between $385 million and $415 million.
